method: Whole-file manual reading of ProfileManager, project, Fody and application XAML; exact-commit download bytes matched Git blob inventory.
findings: ImportProfiles deserializes then clears temporary list before cloning all entries; a null entry/clone failure is swallowed and can leave a partially replaced list with old UI because RefreshPanel not reached. No transactional prepare/commit or error result.

LoadSavedProfiles similarly replaces saved list before cloning temporary copies and swallows exceptions. SaveProfiles filters only absent hotkeys, clones then serializes; enum validity, Delay range, scope and key combinations are not validated here.

ExportProfiles serializes saved state, not temporary editing state. Tray enable mutates saved and temporary objects but does not persist directly; callers may save later. GetProfiles returns read-only list wrapper over mutable profile objects.
SetProfileEnabledFromTray uses First for saved ID and may throw if stale/missing; temporary counterpart may be absent. No synchronization or UI-thread admission here.
Project targets net9.0-windows and net481 with WPF and SHDocVw/Shell32 COM references. Existing net10isolated probes do not qualify original target compatibility, COM build or WPF runtime.
Fody ConfigureAwait sets ContinueOnCapturedContext=false globally, requiring use-site dispatcher handling for UI/COM continuations; STA scheduler alone does not establish continuation affinity.
App resources merge three theme dictionaries; XML structure is declaration only. Package versions are pinned values in source, not current dependency recommendations or vulnerability assessment.
limits: No original build, UI import/export or persistence fault injection performed. No foreign production code adopted.
